name: François Jacob
summary: French molecular biologist and geneticist, cowinner of the 1965 Nobel Prize for physiology or medicine.

name: Institut Pasteur
summary: French research institute devoted to biology, microbiology, and public health, founded by Louis Pasteur.

name: European Molecular Biology Organization
summary: Inter-European structure for molecular biologists created to institutionalize the discipline.

name: European Molecular Biology Laboratory
summary: Inter-European research laboratory for molecular biology modeled on CERN.

name: European Organization for Nuclear Research
summary: European physics research organization that served as an organizational model for molecular biologists.

name: The Logic of Life
summary: Book by François Jacob reconstructing the history of heredity from the seventeenth century to the present.

name: Jacques Monod
summary: French biologist and cowinner of the 1965 Nobel Prize with Jacob, later director of Institut Pasteur.

name: Comité d'Études "Biologie Moléculaire"
summary: French government committee established to coordinate molecular biology research and advise on funding.

name: Comité International d'Études Bio-Anthropologiques et d'anthropologie fondamentale
summary: Committee created to fund a research center on the new discipline of bioanthropology.

name: Paris
summary: Capital city of France, location of Institut Pasteur.

name: Geneva
summary: City in Switzerland, location of CERN and the 1967 EMBC conference.
